termine_desc: Dates for the Einbürgerungstest and the “Leben in Deutschland” test – read from the exam centres' own websites several times a day.
termine_failed_title: The exam dates could not be loaded
termine_failed_body: Please try again later. Every exam centre with its address and phone number is in the list of exam centres.
termine_empty_title: We do not read any dates here yet
termine_empty_body: For this selection we have no exam centre that shows its dates online. Address and phone number of every exam centre are in the list of exam centres.
termine_index_title: Exam centres that show their dates online
termine_index_title_state: Exam centres in {state} that show their dates online
termine_index_hint: The dates are on the exam centre's own website.
termine_directory_hint: In these towns, exam centres show their dates online.
termine_never_read: We could not read this exam centre yet.
termine_unreadable: We cannot read this exam centre's page right now.
termine_no_dates: The exam centre's page shows no date right now.
termine_open_date_aria: Open {title} on {date} on the exam centre's page
termine_watch_full: You already watch {count} exam centres. Remove one to watch another.
termine_watch_hint: We tell you when one of these exam centres shows a new date or a place becomes free.
termine_watch_hint_app: The app looks when you open it and then sends you a notification.
termine_watch_hint_web: In the browser you see it on your next visit. The app for Android and iPhone also sends you a notification.
termine_watch_notifications_off: Notifications are off. Turn them on so the app can notify you.
termine_note_body: We are not an authority and not an exam centre. The information is on the exam centres' websites and can change. You can only register with the exam centre itself.
termine_coverage: So far we read {count} exam centres that show their dates online. Many exam centres give dates only by phone or in person.
termine_centres_body: We only read public course pages, at most four times a day, and follow robots.txt. Should your exam centre not appear here, or is it missing? Write to us – the address is in the legal notice.
termine_inbox_body: {centre}: {when}. You register with the exam centre.
termine_inbox_body_more: {centre}: {when} and {more} more. You register with the exam centre.
termine_channel_desc: New dates and free places at your exam centres
termine_home_body: See dates and free places at exam centres
